operations.description: Set, increase, decrease, multiply or clear one registered policy target.
Open or close a building (by building_id) or every building of a kind in a region, and scale its capacity. Closed businesses stop producing and selling.
Multiply the stock of food, water or supplies at the depots in a region.
Set the share of homes in a region that accept tenants. Scarcer housing pushes market rent up.
Tell an audience something through a channel. Each citizen decides whether to believe it, and believers may pass it on in conversation.
Introduce a condition that changes how credible official sources seem (for example a scandal or a transparency program). Each affected citizen's trust shifts by their own susceptibility.
Promote a social norm. Citizens adopt it or not based on their traits and on whether people they know have adopted it.
Create an organization. Eligible citizens decide whether to join; members act on its mission.
Dissolve an existing organization by organization_id.
Give an audience a per-action or per-tick credit incentive.
Directly edit a personality trait for part of the population. This changes who citizens are, not their environment; use it only when the request is about changing people themselves.
Create acquaintance ties between strangers, or weaken existing ties.
A flood, fire or storm in a region at a severity. Citizens decide how to stay safe.
A festival or community aid distribution in a region.
Heat, cold, illness, pollution or noise in a region. It affects health and stress per tick; being indoors or in hospital mitigates it.

policy_targets.description: Share of each business's revenue paid to the city treasury.
Share of each wage paid to the city treasury.
Fare a rider pays per public transit trip. Fare revenue goes to the treasury.
Fuel, parking and toll cost of one car trip.
Transit frequency and speed. 0 suspends service; 1 is normal; above 1 is faster service that costs the treasury more to operate.
Official encouragement to ride transit instead of driving. Citizens weigh it by how much they trust institutions.
Market rent level relative to today's rents.
Rent control: the highest rent multiplier landlords may charge. Clear it to remove control.
Housing assistance the treasury pays to low-income renters who request it.
Hospital funding. It sets care quality (healing per tick) and capacity, and costs the treasury upkeep above the normal level.
Shop prices relative to today's prices, including food.
Treasury subsidy paid to a business per work shift.
Most units one citizen may gather from a depot per tick. Clear it to remove rationing.
Strength of help and community aid deliveries.
Official evacuation order. Citizens decide whether to comply based on institutional trust and what they observe.
Treasury reward paid to a citizen for each accepted help or trade.
Official campaign asking citizens not to stockpile. Citizens weigh it by institutional trust.

norms.help_strangers: Helping people you do not know, including in shortages.
norms.conserve_resources: Taking only what you need instead of stockpiling.

organizations.mutual_aid: Members with surplus contribute supplies to a pool; members in need draw from it.
organizations.tenant_union: Renters organize, meet at the community center and demand housing help.
organizations.protest_group: Residents rally at the community center on a schedule to press a cause.
organizations.community_program: A funded program that pays a stipend to eligible members who join.
organizations.assistance_office: An office that pays treasury-funded assistance to eligible citizens who apply.

incentives.transit_rebate: Credits returned to the citizen per transit trip.
incentives.help_reward: Credits paid to the citizen per accepted help or trade.
incentives.conservation_bonus: Credits per tick while the citizen keeps a modest inventory (no stockpiling).

metrics.cooperation: Cooperative actions (help, trade, aid transfers) since activation
metrics.social_conflict: Contested claims and recorded disagreements since activation
metrics.policy_compliance: Share of decisions about official directives that complied
metrics.service_access: Share of attempts to enter services that succeeded
metrics.transit_usage: Share of recorded trips taken by public transit
metrics.car_usage: Share of recorded trips taken by car
metrics.walking_trips: Share of recorded trips taken on foot
metrics.financial_strain: Citizens with wallets below the strain threshold
metrics.rent_burden: Mean rent paid per tick in credits
metrics.relocations: Citizens who moved to another home since activation
metrics.assistance_requests: Citizens who requested assistance since activation
metrics.information_shares: Times a citizen passed information to someone else
metrics.belief_adoption: Citizens currently holding a belief introduced by this scenario
metrics.norm_adoption: Citizens who adopted a scenario social norm
metrics.hospital_care: Citizen-ticks of hospital care delivered since activation
metrics.food_access: Food units bought at shops or gathered since activation
